niches.title: General & Admin VA
niches.shortDescription: Broad administrative support - email, calendar, data entry, scheduling, and client communication. The best starting point if you're not sure yet which specialty you want.

niches.title: Social Media Management VA
niches.shortDescription: Content calendars, scheduling, community engagement, and analytics for Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok - built for VAs who want to run a business's social presence.

niches.title: E-commerce VA
niches.shortDescription: Product listings, order fulfillment, and customer service for Shopify and Amazon stores - built for VAs who want to support online sellers.

niches.title: Medical VA
niches.shortDescription: Administrative support for medical practices - scheduling, EHR data entry, insurance verification, and patient communication. Purely administrative, never clinical.

niches.title: Bookkeeping VA
niches.shortDescription: Transaction recording, reconciliation, invoicing, and basic financial reports using QuickBooks and Xero - built for detail-oriented VAs who love keeping numbers organized.

niches.title: Real Estate VA
niches.shortDescription: Listing coordination, lead follow-up, transaction coordination, and marketing support for real estate agents and teams.
